data/reference_v3/build_model.py.name: Rebuilding the platform drawing
data/reference_v3/build_model.py.description: Rebuilds the 3D reference drawing of the platform from its measurements; a reference assembly, not a validated engineering model.

data/reference_v3/render_preview.py.name: Preview pictures of the drawing
data/reference_v3/render_preview.py.description: Renders the real 3D model to pictures you can check by eye, with nothing added or imagined.

data/reference_v3/validate_model.py.name: Checking the drawing files
data/reference_v3/validate_model.py.description: Re-opens the exported drawing files independently and checks they really hold the shape and the scale they claim.

data/reference_v3/viewer_template.html.name: Drawing viewer
data/reference_v3/viewer_template.html.description: A small standalone page for looking at the platform drawing on its own, outside the simulator.
